obeys.text: Left-aligned is primary; centred sparingly (short headings/labels/callouts, small word counts); right rare ("Headline A of the magnetic type construct"); body copy stays horizontal. Never justified (rivers); avoid hyphenation — rebalance lines instead.

obeys.text: Buttons vs links boundary: buttons communicate actions the user can take (submit a form, save settings); "for less prominent actions, we use text links".
obeys.why: edges.obeys on links.meta.json — CROSS-FILE, authored: the buttons spec draws the boundary from the other side — 'for less prominent actions, we use text links'. It binds Links as much as Butto

obeys.text: Links are primarily navigation; they may carry lower-priority actions or many same-priority actions — buttons take higher-priority/fewer actions.
obeys.why: edges.obeys on links.meta.json — States what a Link IS against a Button — primarily navigation, lower-priority or many same-priority actions — which is this meta's `purpose` sentence.

obeys.text: Chevron links carry a red chevron as signposting.
obeys.why: edges.obeys on links.meta.json — Chevron links carry a RED chevron as signposting — fixes the glyph and colour of one of the meta's four family members.

obeys.text: Back links: chevron on the LEFT of the label, pointing left.
obeys.why: edges.obeys on links.meta.json — Back links put the chevron on the LEFT pointing left — the Back link member of the family of four.

obeys.text: Arrow sizing is NUMERIC and font-tier-keyed: font-1…4 → arrow = x-height, on the baseline, text gap = arrow/2 (e.g. font-1: x-height 22px → arrow 22px, gap 11px); font-5…7 → arrow = cap-height, gap = arrow/2 (e.g. font-5: cap 12px → arrow 12px, gap 6px).
obeys.why: edges.obeys on links.meta.json — Arrow sizing is numeric and font-tier-keyed (x-height or cap-height, gap = arrow/2) — the Arrow link's geometry, tied to the type scale this meta already binds.

obeys.text: Wrap behaviour differs by type: arrow links — chevron stays attached to the LAST word, never an orphan line; back/icon links — icon STAYS IN PLACE, aligned to the first line, text aligns left with sentence start.
obeys.why: edges.obeys on links.meta.json — Wrap behaviour differs by type: the arrow stays attached to the last word, the back/icon glyph stays aligned to the first line — per-member layout behaviour.

obeys.text: Only globally recognised icons (per the icons guidelines).
obeys.why: edges.obeys on links.meta.json — Only globally recognised icons, per the icons guidelines — constrains the Icon link member's slot.

obeys.text: Download links: download icon on the LEFT + file format and size in brackets after the label text.
obeys.why: edges.obeys on links.meta.json — Download links: icon on the LEFT plus file format and size in brackets — the meta's own purpose names 'download pdf' as a link job.

obeys.text: External links open in a new tab and carry an indicator icon — the icon sits at the END of the text AS PART OF THE LINK (Default/Hover/Pressed shown in the inline guide).
obeys.why: edges.obeys on links.meta.json — External links open in a new tab with the indicator icon at the END, as PART of the link — fixes both behaviour and anatomy.

obeys.text: Underlined within body text; weight MATCHES the surrounding text weight in ALL states (light text → light link, regular → regular).
obeys.why: edges.obeys on links.meta.json — Underlined within body text, weight MATCHES the surrounding text in all states — binds this molecule's type tokens to its container's.

obeys.text: Hyperlink ≤5 words; linked text descriptive of the destination; prefer the link at the END of the sentence.
obeys.why: edges.obeys on links.meta.json — Hyperlink ≤5 words, descriptive of the destination, preferably at the end of the sentence — content contract for the inline member.

obeys.text: Internal links open in the current tab; external in a new tab.
obeys.why: edges.obeys on links.meta.json — Internal links open in the current tab, external in a new tab — the behaviour half of the external-link rule, stated for both cases.

obeys.text: Hover: text underlines on mouse-over of text OR icon — icon and text behave as ONE wrapped link; the target area wraps both.
obeys.why: edges.obeys on links.meta.json — Hover underlines on mouse-over of text OR icon and the target wraps both — icon and text are ONE link, which is a composition fact about this molecule.

obeys.text: On dark: links and associated icons are white.
obeys.why: edges.obeys on links.meta.json — On dark, links and their icons are white — the per-theme token binding this meta's `tokens` block has to satisfy.

obeys.text: Link text: describe the action or destination; concise; sentence case; ≤8 words (~55 chars); NO 'Click here'/'Learn more'; NO full stop at the end.
obeys.why: edges.obeys on links.meta.json — Link text describes the action or destination, sentence case, ≤8 words, no 'Click here', no full stop — the content contract across the family.

obeys.text: Tags surface KEYWORD DESCRIPTORS: an item's content composition and its relationship to a broader content structure; keywords reusable by other UI patterns for search and filtering.
obeys.why: edges.obeys on tags.meta.json — Defines what a Tag IS for us — a keyword descriptor of content composition — which is this meta's `purpose` sentence, so the rule is the component's definition,

obeys.text: Do link tags to groups or lists of content. Do present tags consistently: ordered alphabetically OR by content priority (most important first), and the chosen order kept consistent throughout the same content structure.
obeys.why: edges.obeys on tags.meta.json — Orders a tag group alphabetically or by content priority and holds that order across a content structure; the Tags atom is always rendered in groups, so the ord

obeys.text: Don't use tag styles for metadata that isn't a keyword descriptor (date, read time), for arbitrary classifications, or to highlight product features.
obeys.why: edges.obeys on tags.meta.json — Bans tag styling for non-keyword metadata (date, read time) — a direct anti-pattern on this atom's variants.

obeys.text: Don't add icons to tags or associate actions other than a standard tag link — "consider using selection pills if sorting or filtering based on keyword descriptors".
obeys.why: edges.obeys on tags.meta.json — Bans icons on tags and any action other than a standard tag link, which fixes this atom's prop surface.

obeys.text: Affordance contract: non-interactive tags must READ as informational (not navigation); tag links must READ as clickable. Two blessed tag-link styles exist (example A/B) — "be consistent in which style you apply throughout the entire section".
obeys.why: edges.obeys on tags.meta.json — The affordance contract: static tags must read informational, tag links must read clickable — the meta's two variants ARE the two sides of this rule.

obeys.text: Placement: tags at the start and/or end of content; NOT normally interactive at the top of an article; below the content, tag links provide useful navigation. Be consistent so users learn the format.
obeys.why: edges.obeys on tags.meta.json — Placement at start and/or end of content, and not interactive at the top of an article — governs where this atom is allowed to appear.

obeys.text: Label centred horizontally and vertically in the container; tags expand horizontally with the label; a GROUP that overflows one row wraps onto two rows; an individual too-long label wraps onto a second line.
obeys.why: edges.obeys on tags.meta.json — Label centred, tag expands horizontally, group wraps to a second row, long label wraps to a second line — the geometry of this atom's container.

obeys.text: Tag copy: keywords describing the content theme · sentence case · never more than THREE words.
obeys.why: edges.obeys on tags.meta.json — Tag copy is a keyword, sentence case, never more than three words — a content constraint on this atom's only slot.
